jobs.title: Railway RRB NTPC Graduate & Under-Graduate Level Recruitment 2026
jobs.intro: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) has officially published the Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) for Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) for Graduate and Undergraduate posts across zonal railways in India. Check eligibility, syllabus, and links below.
jobs.dates:
• Application Begin : 15 October 2026
• Last Date for Apply Online : 13 November 2026 (23:59 PM)
• Last Date Fee Payment : 14 November 2026
• Correction Window : 15 – 24 November 2026
• CBT-1 Exam Date : December 2026 / January 2027
• Admit Card : 4 Days Before Exam
jobs.fee:
• General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 500/- (₹ 400/- refunded after CBT-1)
• SC / ST / PwBD / Female : ₹ 250/- (Full ₹ 250/- refunded after CBT-1)
• Payment Mode : Online Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, UPI
jobs.age:
• UG Posts : 18 – 30 Years (as on 01/01/2027)
• Graduate Posts : 18 – 36 Years (as on 01/01/2027)
• Age relaxation: OBC 3 Yrs, SC/ST 5 Yrs as per Railway Rules.
jobs.qualification:
• Graduate Posts (Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Senior Clerk): Bachelor's Degree in Any Discipline from a recognized University.
• Undergraduate Posts (Junior Clerk cum Typist, Accounts Clerk): 10+2 (Intermediate) Exam Passed with minimum 50% marks + English Typing 30 WPM or Hindi Typing 25 WPM.
jobs.vacancies_detail:
• Station Master : 994 Posts
• Goods Train Manager : 1,215 Posts
• Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk : 850 Posts
• Junior Clerk cum Typist : 990 Posts
• Accounts Clerk cum Typist : 361 Posts
• Commercial cum Ticket Clerk : 755 Posts

jobs.title: SSC CHSL (10+2) LDC, JSA & DEO Recruitment Online Form 2026
jobs.intro: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) invites online applications for the Combined Higher Secondary Level (10+2) Examination 2026 for Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO).
jobs.dates:
• Application Begin : 05 October 2026
• Last Date for Apply Online : 04 November 2026 (23:00 PM)
• Online Fee Payment Last Date : 05 November 2026
• Correction Window : 08 – 10 November 2026
• Tier-1 Computer Based Exam : December 2026
• Tier-2 Skill/Typing Test : To be notified
jobs.fee:
• General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 100/-
• SC / ST / PwD / ESM : ₹ 0/- (Exempted)
• All Female Candidates : ₹ 0/- (Exempted)
• Payment Mode : BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard
jobs.age:
• Minimum Age : 18 Years
• Maximum Age : 27 Years (as on 01/08/2026)
• Candidates must not have been born earlier than 02-08-1999 and later than 01-08-2008.
jobs.qualification:
• Must have passed 12th Standard (10+2) or equivalent examination from a recognized Board/University.
• For DEO Grade 'A' in CAG: 12th Standard pass in Science stream with Mathematics.
• Skill Test: English Typing 35 WPM or Hindi Typing 30 WPM.
jobs.vacancies_detail:
• LDC / JSA : 2,980 Posts
• Data Entry Operator (DEO) : 732 Posts

jobs.title: Bihar BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment Form 2026
jobs.intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) is conducting the Teacher Recruitment Examination (TRE 4.0) for Primary (Class 1-5), Middle (Class 6-8), Secondary (Class 9-10), and Higher Secondary (Class 11-12) School Teachers.
jobs.dates:
• Application Begin : 28 September 2026
• Last Date for Apply Online : 22 October 2026
• Exam Date : 15 – 18 November 2026
• Admit Card Available : 08 November 2026
jobs.fee:
• General / OBC / Other State : ₹ 750/-
• SC / ST / PH (Bihar Domicile) : ₹ 200/-
• All Female Candidates (Bihar Domicile) : ₹ 200/-
• Mode : Online Gateway
jobs.age:
• Minimum Age : 18 Years (Primary) / 21 Years (TGT/PGT)
• Maximum Age : 37 Years (Male), 40 Years (Female)
• Age Cutoff Date : 01/08/2026
jobs.qualification:
• Primary Teacher (1-5): 10+2 with 50% Marks + D.El.Ed + CTET / BTET Paper 1 Passed.
• Middle School (6-8): Bachelor Degree + B.Ed / D.El.Ed + CTET / BTET Paper 2.
• TGT (9-10): Bachelor / Master Degree in Related Subject + B.Ed + STET Paper 1.
• PGT (11-12): Master Degree in Related Subject + B.Ed + STET Paper 2.
